---
title: "Exercise 8: Replication and reporting"
---

1. Apply identical engagement-score preparation to both employee datasets.
2. Compare mean engagement, workload, and performance.
3. Estimate the same regression in both samples.
4. Combine estimates and confidence intervals in one table.
5. Identify the most stable and least stable coefficient.
6. Save the table as CSV.
7. Complete a short results paragraph using actual estimates.
8. List three details another researcher would need to reproduce your work.
